tagline: Leading supplier of nuclear components and technologies for U.S. Government and commercial markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Government Operations revenue is a key driver for BWXT, representing approximately 68% of total revenue in 2025, with structural dependence on U.S. defense contracts.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue of the company
kpis.description: BWXT's total revenue is primarily derived from Government Operations and commercial nuclear operations.
kpis.signal: Significant contraction due to contract adjustments recognized in 2024-2025

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin not disclosed in the 10-K
kpis.description: BWXT does not disclose a consolidated gross margin or separate cost of goods sold in the 10-K.

kpis.name: Government Revenue Proportion
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue from U.S. government contracts
kpis.description: In 2025, U.S. government contracts (direct or subcontracting) represented approximately 68% of total consolidated revenue.

kpis.explanation: Impact of government contract adjustments on 2025 revenue
kpis.description: In 2025, the Government Operations segment benefited from material contract adjustments related to a nuclear operations contract, generating $29.4 million in additional revenue and operating income.
kpis.signal: Favorable adjustments supported results despite overall revenue contraction

risks.title: Dependence on U.S. Government Contracts
risks.score_rationale: BWXT is highly dependent on U.S. government contracts, direct or subcontracted, which represented 68% of total consolidated revenue in 2025. Multi-year contracts are subject to annual congressional appropriations. Any reduction in government funding, particularly at the DoE, could have a material adverse impact on operations and cash flows.

risks.title: Security and Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: BWXT operates in the nuclear defense sector with access to sensitive technologies and classified government information. The company is exposed to cyber threats that could disrupt operations, compromise classified data, and impair its ability to maintain required security clearances for government contracts.

risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Market Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The Commercial Operations segment depends on demand for civilian nuclear power, timing of maintenance outages, and plant renewals. Economic fluctuations and interest rates could affect nuclear investment and demand for BWXT's commercial services and products.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange and International Operations Risks
risks.score_rationale: BWXT has commercial operations in Canada with exposure to foreign exchange fluctuations. The impact of exchange rate changes on international results is managed but could affect reported financial results.

risks.title: Competitive Intensity in Niche Markets
risks.score_rationale: BWXT operates in highly specialized and regulated markets (naval nuclear components, nuclear fuel) where competition is structurally limited by technological and government entry barriers, but existing competitors could impact market share.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: BWXT operates in highly regulated sectors (nuclear defense, civilian nuclear energy, medical radioisotopes) subject to strict government regulations on nuclear safety, environmental protection, and export controls. Regulatory changes could affect operations, compliance costs, and the ability to retain government contracts.

ai_positioning.summary: BWXT does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 10-K filing. There is no indication of AI use or integration in its operations, products, or technology development strategies.
